nodes.title: SG-7.5 · Runner unit tests pass with Git, provider and clock mocked
nodes.body:
Context: backend/worker/internal/runner has tests for each area but TestRunCleanup currently fails because it runs with AutoPublish false, so the approval gate keeps the worktree. Desired behavior: every runner unit test passes, and the six areas (lock held, timeout, retry limit, budget, approval gate, report) are covered including edge paths, with Git (fakeTrees), provider (fakeAgent) and clock (injected now) mocked. Expected result: go test ./internal/runner is green. Why: it proves the execution engine without Git, Claude or real time.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the runner package, When go test ./internal/runner runs, Then all tests pass
- Given each of lock held, timeout, retry limit, budget, approval gate and report, When tests run, Then at least one test asserts its behavior using only fakes


## Scope
- In scope: Runner unit tests and the stale TestRunCleanup expectation
- Out of scope: Real Git worktrees
- Out of scope: Real Claude CLI
- Out of scope: Backend and game modules
- Preserve: runner.go public API and behavior


## Technical constraints
- Go tests only; no network, no real Git, no real clock sleeps beyond 20ms timeouts


## Definition of done
- go test ./internal/runner passes


## Non-functional requirements
- Tests finish in seconds


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Lock held and per-attempt timeout are proven by unit tests
nodes.body:
Context: Run takes lock.Acquire(LockPath) and runAttempt wraps each attempt in context.WithTimeout. Desired behavior: when the lock is held Run fails with lock.ErrLocked leaving the foreign lock file and the store untouched; with retries each attempt times out independently. Why: only one execution per World and bounded run time.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given the lock file exists, When Run is called, Then the lock file still exists afterwards and no execution record is stored
- Given a blocking agent, Timeout 20ms and MaxRetries 1, When Run is called, Then the agent ran twice and the error wraps context.DeadlineExceeded


## Scope
- In scope: Lock and timeout behavior of Runner.Run
- Out of scope: Lock package internals
- Preserve: Existing TestRunLocked and TestRunTimeout


## Technical constraints
- Use fakeAgent block mode


## Definition of done
- Lock and timeout tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Retry limit and budget boundaries are proven by unit tests
nodes.body:
Context: run loops while attempt <= MaxRetries and stops with ErrBudgetExceeded only when spent > MaxBudget with MaxBudget > 0. Desired behavior: MaxRetries 0 runs once; MaxBudget 0 never stops early; spend equal to the budget does not stop. Why: prevents runaway agent cost and silent extra attempts.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given MaxRetries 0 and a failing agent, When Run is called, Then the agent ran once, Attempt is 1 and the error is not ErrBudgetExceeded
- Given MaxBudget 0, cost 100 per call and MaxRetries 2 with all calls failing, When Run is called, Then the agent ran three times and the error is not ErrBudgetExceeded
- Given cost 2.5, MaxBudget 5.0 and MaxRetries 2 with all calls failing, When Run is called, Then the agent ran three times because spend equal to budget is not exceeded


## Scope
- In scope: Retry loop and budget check in run
- Out of scope: Cost calculation by real providers
- Preserve: Existing retry and budget tests


## Technical constraints
- Use fakeAgent cost and errs


## Definition of done
- Retry and budget boundary tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Approval gate and worktree cleanup tests are correct and green
nodes.body:
Context: with AutoPublish false run returns AWAITING_APPROVAL and keeps the worktree, so TestRunCleanup (Config{}) fails expecting a removal. Desired behavior: the cleanup test sets AutoPublish true; failure of Worktrees.Create stops the run before the agent; an agent failure removes the worktree without publishing. Why: the suite must be green and cover the gate and cleanup.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given AutoPublish true and a succeeding agent, When Run is called, Then the worktree is created and removed once and the lock file is gone
- Given Worktrees.Create fails, When Run is called, Then the error wraps it, the agent never ran and the stored status is RUNNING
- Given the agent fails, When Run is called, Then the worktree is removed once and the publisher is not called


## Scope
- In scope: Gate and cleanup tests
- Out of scope: Changing gate semantics
- Preserve: Gate tests in runner_gate_test.go


## Technical constraints
- Gate behavior in runner.go stays as is


## Definition of done
- go test ./internal/runner passes including TestRunCleanup


## Clarifying questions
- None

nodes.title: REQ · Report edge cases are proven with an injected clock and fake reporter
nodes.body:
Context: Run writes a report using r.now for StartedAt and FinishedAt and returns a reporter error only when the run itself succeeded. Desired behavior: durations come from the injected clock; a reporter error is returned on success but never masks a run error; no reporter means no panic. Why: reports must be trustworthy and never hide failures.

## Acceptance criteria
- Given a clock advancing one second per call, When Run succeeds, Then the report DurationMS equals FinishedAt minus StartedAt in milliseconds and is greater than 0
- Given the agent succeeds and the reporter fails, When Run is called, Then the error wraps the reporter error
- Given the agent fails with boom and the reporter fails, When Run is called, Then the error is boom
- Given no reporter is set, When Run is called, Then it returns without panic


## Scope
- In scope: Report writing in Run
- Out of scope: report package internals
- Preserve: Existing report tests


## Technical constraints
- Set h.r.now directly in same-package tests


## Definition of done
- Report edge tests pass


## Clarifying questions
- None
